text: {"lessons":["My account value has fallen from 106,254 to 102,128 despite some up months; I need to assess performance over time against a market benchmark, not rely on isolated wins or losses.","Repeatedly buying and selling without a clear, consistent rationale can lead to poor timing; before each trade I should write down what has changed and what would invalidate my view.","I should avoid letting my purchase price dictate whether to hold or sell, and instead weigh each stock's current prospects against the risks and alternatives, while keeping position sizes manageable."]}
